# `ISSUE-ID` — `Outcome`

Template: replace placeholders; omit inapplicable sections. For small bugs, combine this with the plan and verification sections in one concise record.

Issue: `URL and number`
Status: Proposed
Updated: `date, Asia/Dhaka`

## Problem and inspected baseline

Who is affected, actual current behavior and source/code evidence. For bugs, include reproduction, expected versus actual results and environment. Distinguish implemented behavior, unverified behavior and proposed behavior.

## Outcome and scope

- Outcome: `observable result`
- Included: `bounded changes`
- Excluded: `related work deferred`
- Dependencies: `issue IDs and gates`

## Required behavior

Describe normal and applicable error/empty/pending/denied/stale states, permissions/ownership, edge cases and historical-data expectations. Identify institutional facts needing an answer; do not invent defaults to clear a gate. Include relevant UI/export/print expectations.

## Acceptance criteria

| ID | Observable condition | Verification method |
|---|---|---|
| AC-01 | `Given a condition, when an action occurs, expected result` | `meaningful check/flow` |

## Decisions and sources

Link relevant approved decisions, source sections and architecture records. Identify unanswered questions, owner and affected work. Technical task details belong in the implementation plan; actual approval belongs in its approval record.
